newsitem.title: USA: Semco to acquire construction company.
newsitem.headline: Semco to acquire construction company.

text.p: Semco Energy Inc said Monday it has agreed to acquire the assets of Michigan-based Sub-Surface Construction Co for $15.4 million in cash plus the assumption of certain liabilities.
Sub-Surface primarily constructs underground natural gas distribution pipelines, service lines and associated facilities, Semco said. Closing is anticipated later this month.
"With this acquisition, the first of many planned efforts to diversify and expand the scope of our business comes to fruition," William Johnson, chief executive officer, said in a news release.

Sub-Surface is a privately held construction company headquartered in Comstock Park, Michigan that operates five facilities in Michigan. The company is debt-free and has an annual revenue of about $33 million, Semco said.
